subject: physics
question_text: What is a geostationary satellite? State its uses.

verification.note: The mark split is invented and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. The question itself is sourced, not invented. AI physics check 2026-08-24: formulas, signs, numbers and claims verified against NCERT Class-11 conventions; corrections applied to explanation text (why / common_mistakes / memory_tip), marked answer lines unchanged unless factually wrong.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

steps.label: The definition
lines: A satellite whose period of revolution is equal
to the period of rotation of the earth is called
Its time period is 24 hours; it moves from west
to east in the plane of the equator, at a height
of about 36 000 km. Its velocity relative to the
earth is zero, so it stays above the same point
steps.why: "Relative velocity zero" is the whole idea: an antenna on the ground can be aimed once and left alone.
common_mistakes: Saying it does not move at all — it moves very fast; it simply keeps pace with the ground below.

recall.must_convey: That its period equals the earth rotation period of 24 hours, so it stays above the same point on the ground.

steps.memory_tip: Three matches make it geostationary: same period (24 h), same direction (west to east), over the equator.
steps.margin_note: Two marks. The matching-period sentence earns one; height, direction and plane earn the other.

steps.label: The uses
lines: 3) Studying the upper layers of the atmosphere.
4) Studying the shape and size of the earth.
steps.why: Every use follows from one property: it serves ONE region without a break. Use 4 is the source book’s list; strip-by-strip surveying of the WHOLE earth needs a polar satellite instead.
common_mistakes: Listing whole-earth surveying, which needs a POLAR satellite instead.

recall.must_convey: Uses such as communication and television relay, weather forecasting, and studying the atmosphere.

steps.memory_tip: All uses are one property repeated: it never moves off its spot — TV relay, communication, weather watch of one region.
steps.margin_note: Two marks for the uses. A numbered list of four reads as four separate points.

insider_note: Half the marks are for the uses, so a long definition with two uses added at the end still drops marks — number four of them.
